data.title: China's August Urban Surveyed Unemployment Rate Rises to 5.3%
data.description: China's urban surveyed unemployment rate rose to 5.3% in August from 5.2% in July, up 0.1 percentage point, mainly because new graduates entered the labor market, Fu Linghui, spokesperson for China's National Bureau of Statistics and chief economist, said at a State Council Information Office briefing on September 15, according to Jiemian News. Fu said the surveyed unemployment rate for the 30-59 age group was 3.9%, unchanged from both the previous month and a year earlier. He added that manufacturing employment remained broadly stable, jobs in information transmission, software and information technology services increased significantly, and employment in accommodation and catering continued to expand on the back of domestic tourism and leisure demand.

data.title: Airbnb Appoints Kong Zhiqiu as Asia Head, He Changhua as China Head
data.description: Airbnb announced on September 15 that Kong Zhiqiu will become head of its Asia business, with overall responsibility for operations in China, Japan, South Korea, India and Southeast Asia. He Changhua will become head of Airbnb China and continue to report to Kong, according to Jiemian News. He will oversee Airbnb's China business, help formulate and implement local market strategy, deepen ties with partners across markets, and strengthen communication with local communities and stakeholders.

data.title: GitLab CE/EE Path Traversal Flaw Rated CVSS 10, Security Patch Released
data.description:
GitLab CE/EE has a critical path traversal vulnerability, CVE-2026-85706, with a CVSS score of 10. According to ChainCatcher, unauthenticated attackers could use the Repository Commits API to read arbitrary files on affected GitLab servers.

GitLab has released a security patch. Affected versions include releases from 18.7 to before 19.1.8, from 19.2 to before 19.2.6, and from 19.3 to before 19.3.2. Self-managed GitLab users are advised to upgrade immediately to 19.1.8, 19.2.6, or 19.3.2 and check logs and any potentially exposed credentials after patching.

data.title: Ult Rebrands From Cronos App, Set to Launch on September 17
data.description:
Foresight News reported that the former Cronos App has been renamed Ult (Ultimate) and will launch on September 17. According to Foresight News, the platform will support spot crypto trading, stocks, commodities, crypto perpetual contracts, sports prediction markets, and deposits through Apple Pay, bank cards, or cryptocurrency on its first day.

Ult said it will not issue a token, and any ULT token is unrelated to Ult, Cronos Labs, or Cronos Network. The company also said all revenue will be used to buy and burn CRO on the open market, with the team planning to carry out the process on-chain monthly and publish transaction details.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Thailand Sees Foreign Investment Surge as Stability Returns
data.description:

The country had been rocked for years by coups and court-ordered dismissals of prime ministers.

data.title: South Korea Finance Nominee Sees Economy at Turning Point
data.description:

He said shifts in the chip cycle, global interest rates and geopolitical tensions also pose risks.

data.title: STOCKS | JPMorgan Keeps Buy Rating On Techtronic, Sees Strong 2027 Momentum
data.description:
JPMorgan said Techtronic Industries management still expects to meet full-year guidance despite market concerns over higher interest rates, rising shipping and commodity costs, macro volatility and a slowdown in some AI data center development, according to ETNet.

The bank said the company’s consumer business has performed well after exiting lower-margin brands such as Hart and refocusing on core power tools and outdoor products. Management expects more innovation and consumer-led demand from 2027 onward.

JPMorgan added that Milwaukee continues to post global success, supported by its exposure to data centers and critical infrastructure. The company’s cash flow remains strong, backing a disciplined capital-allocation strategy that includes ongoing buybacks and higher dividends, while free cash flow and EBIT both hit record highs.

Although management has not issued formal 2027 guidance, JPMorgan said it is confident Milwaukee can deliver low-double-digit revenue growth and expects rising AI data center contributions to accelerate profit growth. It said management kept its 2027 EBIT margin target at 10%.

The bank maintained its overweight rating and HK$179 target price, saying Techtronic remains one of its top picks in industrials and that the stock, up about 40% year to date, should continue to outperform into year-end.

data.title: UK House of Lords Approves Amendment Requiring National Digital Asset Strategy
data.description:
The UK House of Lords passed an amendment by 194 votes to 138 requiring the Treasury to draft, publish, and consult on a national digital asset strategy within 12 months of the Financial Services and Markets Act taking effect. According to Odaily, the strategy must cover crypto assets, qualifying stablecoins, central bank digital currencies, tokenized securities, and other digital financial assets, while also reviewing access to banking, payments, and settlement services and the risks to competition and innovation from withdrawing those services.

The bill still needs a third reading in the House of Lords on September 15 before moving to the House of Commons. The Financial Conduct Authority completed rules and guidance for the new crypto asset regulatory regime on June 30, with the authorization application channel set to open on September 30, 2026, and the regime due to take effect on October 25, 2027.

data.title: Doubao Second-Generation Phone Uses Edge-Cloud Collaboration for Consumer and Preview Versions
data.description: Doubao’s second-generation phone uses an edge-cloud collaboration approach in both its earlier technical preview and its consumer version. According to ChainCatcher, the phone assistant prioritizes on-device processing, but complex tasks that require cloud support are handled with a minimized data-upload approach. The overall edge-cloud collaboration design has not changed.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Xiaomi Says New 18 Pro Series Will Launch This Month
data.description:
Xiaomi Group (01810) partner and president Lu Weibing said on Weibo that the new Xiaomi 18 Pro series will be launched this month, calling it the biggest upgrade in the company’s digital series to date, according to ETNet.

Lu said the Xiaomi 18 Pro series will see significant improvements in performance, imaging, battery life and AI capabilities. He also highlighted Xiaomi’s proprietary “Magic Back Screen,” saying daily use of app cards on the rear display exceeded 4 million times last year and wallpaper additions topped 3.5 million times in a single day.

Lu said user demand for the rear screen is diverse and that Xiaomi will adopt a more advanced solution this year to make the experience much richer.

data.title: Oil Prices And Treasury Yields Move In Lockstep As Correlation Hits 0.96
data.description:
According to CNBC, the one-month rolling correlation between front-month West Texas Intermediate crude and the 10-year Treasury yield has risen to 0.96, the strongest positive relationship since June 2019 and before that October 2014. The synchronized move comes as oil prices have surged on conflict in the Middle East, while the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield briefly topped 5% Monday for the first time since October 2023.

Billy Leung, investment strategist at Global X ETFs, said a further rise in oil would transmit more directly into financial conditions by lifting inflation expectations, delaying Federal Reserve easing and raising the discount rate applied to equities and credit. Ed Yardeni, president of Yardeni Research, said higher oil prices would point to higher bond yields and inflation expectations, increasing the odds of a tightening cycle and potentially two or three more rate hikes. Komal Sri-Kumar, president of Sri-Kumar Global Strategies, said he sees a bond bear market ahead and does not see anything stopping the rise in oil and natural gas prices.

Andy Lipow, president of Lipow Oil Associates, said higher energy prices feed into gasoline costs and into goods and services transported by truck and rail, while higher Treasury yields raise borrowing costs for mortgages, auto loans and other financing. He also said the combination is bad news for consumers and can increase financing costs for inventories and investment, including capital-intensive artificial intelligence buildouts and related energy infrastructure. Leung said the 0.96 correlation is unusually high but could unwind if geopolitical tensions ease or growth fears take over.
